source_refs.note: Unnumbered heading Reasoning and drawing conclusions under 2.10, as printed (PDF 33, printed 29).

blocks.text: Using predicate logic, we can draw conclusions from given facts. For example, if “∀x, Student(x) → HasLibraryCard(x)” and “Ali is a student,” then we conclude “Ali has a library card.”
This logical reasoning helps in decision making, such as checking whether a student can borrow a book. It ensures correct and consistent conclusions, making the system reliable and easy to manage.
